Please confirm the following (reply with the exact choices):

1) Recipient — confirm address to send to:
   - e.lindqvist@meridian-partners.example (confirm correct: yes / no / provide alternate)

2) Scope — what to include:
   - Forward the entire thread titled "Ridgeline arbitration - counsel memo and exposure ranges": yes / no
   - Include attachments: yes / no
   - Include original To/Cc headers (so recipient sees original recipients): yes / no

3) Operation:
   - Send now, or create a draft for you to review? (send now / create draft)

4) Introductory note:
   - Add a short note to Erik? If yes, paste the text you want included or say "Please draft" and I will propose one.

5) Approval note:
   - Include a line that "Sanjay (legal ops) signed off on sharing"? (include / do not include)
   - Note: I cannot independently verify Sanjay’s sign-off; you provided that information.

Once you confirm these points, I will proceed. I will not send anything until you explicitly confirm.
